## Journal articles

```{r}
# Journal articles from the CV's biblatex file (allarticles.bib), newest first, grouped by year.
# To update: download allarticles.bib from Overleaf into the project root and re-render.
library(RefManageR)
library(dplyr)

clean <- function(x) gsub("[{}]|\\.$", "", gsub("\\\\&", "&", gsub("--", "–", x)))

pubs <- as.data.frame(ReadBib("../allarticles.bib", check = FALSE)) |>
  mutate(year = coalesce(year, substr(date, 1, 4)),
         doi = sub("https://doi.org/", "", doi),
         author = gsub(" and ", ", ", sub("Francesca Pia Vantaggiato", "**Francesca Pia Vantaggiato**", author)),
         details = ifelse(is.na(pages) | pages == "", volume, paste0(volume, ", ", clean(pages)))) |>
  arrange(desc(year))

entries <- with(pubs, paste0(
  author, ". ", year, ". ", clean(title), ". *", clean(journal), "* ", details,
  ifelse(is.na(doi) | doi == "", "", paste0(". [doi:", doi, "](https://doi.org/", doi, ")"))))

by_year <- rev(split(entries, pubs$year))
knitr::asis_output(paste0("### ", names(by_year), "\n\n",
                          sapply(by_year, paste0, collapse = "\n\n"), collapse = "\n\n"))
```
